plugins.name: wilson-git-guard
plugins.description: Deny force-push: a Bash `git push` carrying --force / -f / a +refspec (and --force-with-lease unless SIDECAR_ALLOW_FORCE_WITH_LEASE=1) is blocked at PreToolUse. Standalone port of wilson git-guard â working.
plugins.author: dancinlab

plugins.name: wilson-secret-guard
plugins.description: Block live secrets before they land. PreToolUse (Write/Edit/MultiEdit): deny writing a real .env file or content carrying a high-confidence credential (AWS / GitHub / GitLab / Anthropic / OpenAI / Slack / Google / Stripe tokens, PEM private keys). UserPromptSubmit: block a prompt that pastes one. High-confidence patterns only â near-zero false positives. Opt out: SIDECAR_NO_SECRET_GUARD=1.
plugins.author: dancinlab

plugins.name: wilson-bash-guard
plugins.description: Deny catastrophic Bash commands at PreToolUse â pipe-to-shell from a network downloader (curl|sh), `rm -rf` of a root/home path, fork bombs, disk destroyers (dd of=/dev/disk, mkfs, >/dev/sd*), and recursive chmod/chown on / ~ or `.`. High-confidence destructive patterns only â near-zero false positives. Complements wilson-git-guard (force-push) and wilson-dangerous-path (protected-path writes). Opt out: SIDECAR_NO_BASH_GUARD=1.
plugins.author: dancinlab

plugins.name: wilson-checkpoint
plugins.description: Never lose work to a usage limit / rate-limit / crash. A CC hook cannot see the limit event, so this keeps an always-fresh non-destructive snapshot instead: on Stop / PreCompact / SessionEnd it runs `git stash create` (a dangling commit â working tree, index and branches untouched), pins it under refs/wilson-checkpoint/, and writes a resume note; SessionStart re-injects an unconsumed snapshot so the next session continues. Restore/list/clear via /wilson-checkpoint:checkpoint (restore is printed, never auto-applied). Debounced; git-only. Opt out: SIDECAR_NO_CHECKPOINT=1.
plugins.author: dancinlab

plugins.name: wilson-gpu
plugins.description: Rented-GPU cost guardrail + lifecycle for RunPod / Vast.ai. SessionStart surfaces every still-billing instance (uptime + estimated cost so far) so a forgotten pod never leaks money; /wilson-gpu down is the kill switch and attach wires an instance into the wilson-pool roster. Operating strategies: watch (visibility), budget ($ ceiling escalation), idle-reaper (flag past max-hours), ephemeral (flag wilson-gpu-provisioned). Money/destroy are double-gated by SEPARATE off-by-default switches: provisioning (up also needs --yes) and reaping (any strategy auto-down). fanout is a cost-tolerance decision aid for shardable jobs (on/off, OFF by default â never auto-executes). Inert unless runpodctl / vastai is on PATH. Opt out: SIDECAR_NO_GPU=1.
plugins.author: dancinlab

plugins.name: wilson-decision-gate
plugins.description: Step-by-step decision gate â multi-decision work is one user-confirmation gate per decision, never batched: for each branch point present options + recommendation + rationale (3+ bullets), wait for the pick, then record a `### Decision N` block in design.md. Standalone port of wilson's principle-step-by-step-decision-gate (text-only, like wilson â a hook can't detect batching either). SessionStart injects the principle once; UserPromptSubmit adds a short reminder ONLY on branch-point-looking prompts (not every prompt). /wilson-decision-gate maintains the design.md ledger; ships a 5-language canonical sample. Default ON; opt out: SIDECAR_NO_DECISION_GATE.
plugins.author: dancinlab

plugins.name: wilson-lsp
plugins.description: Wires LSP servers for the dancinlab formats via .lsp.json: .hexa â `hexa lsp`; .tape / .n6 / .hxc / .kosmos â the canonical per-repo servers (tape-lsp / n6-lsp / hxc-lsp / kosmos-lsp, shipped in github.com/dancinlab/{tape,n6,hxc,kosmos}).
